body:
Pray. Serve. Vote.
| | | March 22, 2026 | [**Read Online**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/48hvhehml0pmwosx/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvbXZ1N2g1aHE1NXoya2Z2NW9vNDV3aXIyN21rMHJjM2g5ZHJvcQ==) |
---
| Hi Friend — What extraordinary days we find ourselves in. I hope you’re well. Here are just a few of this week’s twists and turns at True the Vote — along with ways to take action. Let's jump in! **Konnech-ing the Dots** [** _News outlets are reporting the release of a government advisory acknowledging_**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/08hwh9h2em92v9fl/aHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvYW5kbWFnYXppbmUvcC93aHktZGlkLXRoZS1iaWRlbi1hZG1pbmlzdHJhdGlvbj9yPWdwdXkyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09aW9z) __ China’s intervention in U.S elections. True the Vote has not been referenced in the coverage, so we've had lots of folks reach out to ask whether these developments were connected to our prior research on Konnech. The answer requires context. For those who don’t know the story ... | [](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/vqh3hrho0nvol3ag/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9UcnVlVGhlVm90ZS9zdGF0dXMvMjAzNDA0MjA5NDAwNDg3NTMzOD9zPTIw)**_https://x.com/TruetheVote/status/2034042094004875338?s=20_**
---
In 2021, Gregg Phillips and I identified and researched a company called Konnech and reported our very troubling findings to the FBI.
Konnech is an election software company that runs elections end-to-end — including poll worker staffing and payroll, scheduling, inventory control, password management, e-poll books, scanners, and access to voter files. All of it. Operating in some of the largest counties in the country. All being run out of China.
We worked with the FBI for the next 18 months, believing they were preparing to shut down Konnech ahead of the 2022 elections. Over time, it became clear the FBI was doing nothing about Konnech and, in fact, we had become the target.
Because we knew Konnech posed a serious national security risk, in August of 2022 Gregg and I made the decision to go public rather than allow it to be covered up.
_In the six weeks that followed our presentation of Konnech data at an event in Arizona, we were sued, debanked, I was poisoned, Gregg was undergoing cancer treatments, a Grand Jury was convened against Gregg and I in the Southern District of New York seizing all our records in the process, a defamation lawsuit was filed to try to intimidate us, and we were charged with contempt of court for refusing to disclose a source, then held in solitary confinement in an ICE prison. Ultimately, we were released by Emergency Order of the 5th circuit, the judge recused himself, and the lawsuit against us was dropped._
Yup.
I wish that weren’t a story I had to tell. But it’s a good indication of just how disruptive our exposé was to the Biden Administration. [**_They wanted us silenced. They failed._******](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/m2h7h5h35oq3vnhm/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcva29ubmVjaC1jb2xsZWN0aW9u)
We provided all the Konnech information to the FBI/Department of Justice in 2021, 2022, and 2025. If there is the will to act, we remain ready to assist. They may already have all they need. We don’t know. We do know many counties terminated their Konnech contracts, including DeKalb County GA, Lake County IL, Wayne County (Detroit) MI, Allegheny County PA and others. Hard fought, but worthy victories.
So, I don’t know whether recently published government documents pertain to Konnech or not. We were not notified. But Konnech is very real. And our position on it has not changed.
* * *
**Meanwhile, in the Senate...**
Attention remains focused on what is happening with the SAVE America Act, now actively being debated in the Senate. The bill is encountering the procedural reality of that chamber: advancing it will almost certainly require 60 votes to move forward.
With only 53 Republicans, that threshold is extremely unlikely to be reached.
BUT — even if the bill cannot clear the 60-vote threshold, the filibuster process matters. It compels a public debate — one where Americans can hear, in plain terms, why the Democrats oppose voter ID and citizen-only voting requirements. [**_Let ’em talk!_**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/e0hph7h7vkl760h8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGJzLm9yZy9uZXdzaG91ci9wb2xpdGljcy93YXRjaC1saXZlLXNlbmF0ZS1iZWdpbnMtY29uc2lkZXJhdGlvbi1vZi1zYXZlLWFtZXJpY2EtYWN0) The only other option is for Senator Thune to raise a procedural point to reinterpret Senate rules and then a simple majority (51 votes) could overrule the filibuster requirement and pass the bill. The catch? Once done, it's permanent. And no matter how they try to carve it out, it should be assumed that the new rule will apply to all similar legislation in the future. Heretofore, this procedure has only been used to lower the cloture threshold for nominations, but never on ordinary legislation.
**But wait, there's more: States Plan to Block Reform**
Meanwhile, as the debate unfolds in D.C., coordinated activity at the state level is already moving forward.
The canary in the coal mine seems to be Rhode Island. [**_Their newly introduced bill offers a clear example of how some states are acting preemptively_**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/owhkhqhw946wpgbv/aHR0cHM6Ly93ZWJzZXJ2ZXIucmlsZWdpc2xhdHVyZS5nb3YvQmlsbFRleHQvQmlsbFRleHQyNi9Ib3VzZVRleHQyNi9IODMzNC5wZGY=) to insulate against the federal reforms the Save America Act will introduce. The RI bill creates new categories of disadvantaged voters We should expect to see many more bills like this one — and soon.
Under the 10th Amendment, states have broad authority to manage their own elections, and we support that wholeheartedly, but, particularly in blue states, we should expect efforts to codify expansive “voter victim” classifications and construct legal frameworks that make meaningful reform increasingly difficult to implement.
This is not incidental. It is strategic. It is also exactly why we built LegiTrack.
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/p8heh9h46924m8sq/bGVnaXRyYWNrLm9yZw==)[**https://legitrack.org/**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/x0hph6he2npeokc5/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3JnLw==)
---

LegiTrack allows you to see these bills as they are introduced, understand what they do, and engage before they become law. If you haven’t signed up yet, now is the time.
Bottom line: The federal government can guide elections in important ways, but states ultimately control them. That means engagement is required at both levels — and your home state remains your most immediate and effective line of defense.
In April, we'll begin hosting weekly online discussions. LegiTrack will be on the permanent agenda.
To find out more, go to [**LegiTrack.org**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/p8heh9h46924m8sq/bGVnaXRyYWNrLm9yZw==)**!**

* * *
**Community — It’s a Good Thing**
We’re excited to share that the TTV NOW community has officially launched.
This is a place to connect — human to human. Inside TTV NOW, you can engage with others in your state and county, explore our apps, resources, and trainings, join conversations that matter, and begin building real relationships with real people who’re committed to saving the Republic.
While election integrity remains at the core, we expect this community to grow well beyond it — including prayer groups, special interest groups, and opportunities for connection at every level. Because we need a place to find each other again.
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/6qheh8hlrp5lzzio/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI=)[**https://community.ttvnow.org/checkout/become-a-member**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/6qheh8hlrp5lzzio/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI=)
---
**Important Note:** We built this platform with security in mind. The onboarding process is intentionally rigorous to keep bots and bad actors out. **This is a humans-only community** , designed to support authentic connection and trust. If you’ve been looking for a place to plug in, you found it.
* * *
**What's The Takeaway?**
What we’ve laid out here, from what was uncovered and endured, to what is now unfolding in the Senate, to what is already taking shape in the states — is not disconnected. It is part of a larger pattern.
A pattern of chaos and managed decline that must be seen clearly in order to be stopped.
We’re building the tools to see it. We’re building a community to respond to it. And we will continue the work — steadily, with clarity, strengthening as we grow.
We will face tests along the way. But what is tested and endures becomes unshakable.
Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW!

Ever onward —

---
**P.S.** None of this work happens on its own. The research, tools like LegiTrack, the launch of TTV NOW — it all requires real resources and sustained effort behind the scenes. If you’ve followed this far, you understand what’s at stake. [**_We need support to continue our work. If you can donate, we would truly appreciate your help._**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/58hvh7hgx5ngq2b6/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ==)
**P.P.S.** You may have seen recent media coverage targeting Gregg Phillips. CNN did a hit piece and we understand Rolling Stone and others are soon to follow.
Gregg’s current work with FEMA has renewed media interest, because it serves their narrative to portray him in an uncharitable light.
**Normally, I wouldn’t give this more oxygen, but in this case, I think it’s worth it.**
In January 2025, I hosted a podcast on _Onward_ , with Gregg as my guest. He was in the first week of an intense protocol in his fight against metastatic bone cancer (which, if you know Gregg, you can tell). We had an unfiltered conversation about his battle, the battles we’d shared, and the ongoing odyssey it has been. During that conversation, we also discussed a series of experiences Gregg had that cannot be explained in conventional terms.
For lack of a better word, we referred to those experiences as “teleportations” — instances where Gregg was moved, inexplicably, across distances and into new locations in a matter of minutes. Live and unedited, I asked Gregg to describe what happened.

[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/qvh8h7hdw84dzmil/aHR0cHM6Ly9ydW1ibGUuY29tL3Y3N2ZtbjQtb2YtcG9saXRpY3MtYW5kLXByb3RvY29scy1yZWFwaW5nLXRoZS13aGlybHdpbmRzLmh0bWw=)[**h** _**ttps://rumble.com/v77fmn4-of-politics-and-protocols-reaping-the-whirlwinds.html**_](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/qvh8h7hdw84dzmil/aHR0cHM6Ly9ydW1ibGUuY29tL3Y3N2ZtbjQtb2YtcG9saXRpY3MtYW5kLXByb3RvY29scy1yZWFwaW5nLXRoZS13aGlybHdpbmRzLmh0bWw=)
---
The podcast, along with a thirty-year-plus scrape of manufactured controversies, has now been bundled and is making the rounds of the mockingbird media.
If you're new here and don’t know me or Gregg, you may wonder what to make of it all.
Here’s what I can tell you. Beyond the out-of-context comments and recitations of conjured nonsense, there are some things in the article that were true — Gregg’s “teleportations,” or whatever you want to call them, happened. We know how it sounds. It is nonetheless true.
**It’s often said that our world is in a battle between good and evil. Stop for a moment and consider what that really means. This is a spiritual battle.**
**And with that comes things we can’t fully explain — angels, demons, supernatural events — just as the Bible describes. We don’t claim to understand it all. But when something supernatural is experienced, especially in the midst of this kind of battle, it should be spoken of, in its time. And now is the time, because the battle is real.**
**_“For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.” — Ephesians 6:12_**
To see what all the attention is about, [**_here's the full episode_****.**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/v8ugklp2w3trhv00rm2cghv0dp3geb9h0lxm2/9qhzhnhdwg6d05t9/aHR0cHM6Ly9vbndhcmQubG9jYWxzLmNvbS9wb3N0LzY1OTc5Mzcvb2YtcG9saXRpY3MtYW5kLXByb3RvY29scy1yZWFwaW5nLXRoZS13aGlybHdpbmRz)****
For those who want to explore further, Scripture contains many accounts of individuals being transported or moved in ways that defy ordinary explanation including in Acts 8:39–40; Ezekiel 3:12–14, 8:3, and 11:24; 2 Kings 2:11; John 6:21; Matthew 4:5, 8; 2 Corinthians 12:2–4; and 1 Thessalonians 4:17.
We are living in days of miracles. Maybe you have already experienced something supernatural in your life — if not, stay awake, you will. When you do, don’t ignore it. Tell others! What is shared does not diminish — it emboldens, and it points to the Kingdom.
In all cases, rejoice — and gird up! There’s much work to be done. Ever onward!

The catch? Once done, it's permanent. And no matter how they try to carve it out, it should be assumed that the new rule will apply to all similar legislation in the future. Heretofore, this procedure has only been used to lower the cloture threshold for nominations, but never on ordinary legislation. But wait, there's more: States Plan to Block Reform Meanwhile, as the debate unfolds in D.C., coordinated activity at the state level is already moving forward. The canary in the coal mine seems to be Rhode Island. = to insulate against the federal reforms the Save America Act will introduce. The RI bill creates new categories of disadvantaged voters We should expect to see many more bills like this one — and soon. Under the 10th Amendment, states have broad authority to manage their own elections, and we support that wholeheartedly, but, particularly in blue states, we should expect efforts to codify expansive “voter victim” classifications and construct legal frameworks that make meaningful reform increasingly difficult to implement. This is not incidental. It is strategic. It is also exactly why we built LegiTrack. == LegiTrack allows you to see these bills as they are introduced, understand what they do, and engage before they become law. If you haven’t signed up yet, now is the time. Bottom line: The federal government can guide elections in important ways, but states ultimately control them. That means engagement is required at both levels — and your home state remains your most immediate and effective line of defense. In April, we'll begin hosting weekly online discussions. LegiTrack will be on the permanent agenda. To find out more, go to ==! Community — It’s a Good Thing We’re excited to share that the TTV NOW community has officially launched. This is a place to connect — human to human. Inside TTV NOW, you can engage with others in your state and county, explore our apps, resources, and trainings, join conversations that matter, and begin building real relationships with real people who’re committed to saving the Republic. While election integrity remains at the core, we expect this community to grow well beyond it — including prayer groups, special interest groups, and opportunities for connection at every level. Because we need a place to find each other again. = Important Note: We built this platform with security in mind. The onboarding process is intentionally rigorous to keep bots and bad actors out. This is a humans-only community , designed to support authentic connection and trust. If you’ve been looking for a place to plug in, you found it. What's The Takeaway? What we’ve laid out here, from what was uncovered and endured, to what is now unfolding in the Senate, to what is already taking shape in the states — is not disconnected. It is part of a larger pattern. A pattern of chaos and managed decline that must be seen clearly in order to be stopped. We’re building the tools to see it. We’re building a community to respond to it. And we will continue the work — steadily, with clarity, strengthening as we grow. We will face tests along the way. But what is tested and endures becomes unshakable. Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW! Ever onward — P.S. None of this work happens on its own. The research, tools like LegiTrack, the launch of TTV NOW — it all requires real resources and sustained effort behind the scenes. If you’ve followed this far, you understand what’s at stake. == P.P.S. You may have seen recent media coverage targeting Gregg Phillips. CNN did a hit piece and we understand Rolling Stone and others are soon to follow. Gregg’s current work with FEMA has renewed media interest, because it serves their narrative to portray him in an uncharitable light. Normally, I wouldn’t give this more oxygen, but in this case, I think it’s worth it. In January 2025, I hosted a podcast on Onward , with Gregg as my guest. He was in the first week of an intense protocol in his fight against metastatic bone cancer (which, if you know Gregg, you can tell). We had an unfiltered conversation about his battle, the battles we’d shared, and the ongoing odyssey it has been. During that conversation, we also discussed a series of experiences Gregg had that cannot be explained in conventional terms. For lack of a better word, we referred to those experiences as “teleportations” — instances where Gregg was moved, inexplicably, across distances and into new locations in a matter of minutes. Live and unedited, I asked Gregg to describe what happened. = The podcast, along with a thirty-year-plus scrape of manufactured controversies, has now been bundled and is making the rounds of the mockingbird media. If you're new here and don’t know me or Gregg, you may wonder what to make of it all. Here’s what I can tell you. Beyond the out-of-context comments and recitations of conjured nonsense, there are some things in the article that were true — Gregg’s “teleportations,” or whatever you want to call them, happened. We know how it sounds. It is nonetheless true. It’s often said that our world is in a battle between good and evil. Stop for a moment and consider what that really means. This is a spiritual battle. And with that comes things we can’t fully explain — angels, demons, supernatural events — just as the Bible describes. We don’t claim to understand it all. But when something supernatural is experienced, especially in the midst of this kind of battle, it should be spoken of, in its time. And now is the time, because the battle is real. “For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.” — Ephesians 6:12_ To see what all the attention is about, ** For those who want to explore further, Scripture contains many accounts of individuals being transported or moved in ways that defy ordinary explanation including in Acts 8:39–40; Ezekiel 3:12–14, 8:3, and 11:24; 2 Kings 2:11; John 6:21; Matthew 4:5, 8; 2 Corinthians 12:2–4; and 1 Thessalonians 4:17. We are living in days of miracles. Maybe you have already experienced something supernatural in your life — if not, stay awake, you will. When you do, don’t ignore it. Tell others! What is shared does not diminish — it emboldens, and it points to the Kingdom. In all cases, rejoice — and gird up! There’s much work to be done. Ever onward! | | Update your or unsubscribe © 2025 True the Vote 3120 Southwest Frwy Ste 101, PMB 19128, Houston, Texas 77098-4520

# [In the Spotlight!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/03/22/in-the-spotlight/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on March 22, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 03.22.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e93a24239e67be3d2adc19811f0a317631c4ce4548517ce81962844db35e65c5&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=4651868a36a53a2a03c107ba4ef8f930&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)**
---

**Franklin County Cares!**
---
How do the votes of our US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, actively harm his own constituency?
---
– His votes remove food assistance from our hungry neighbors.
---
– His votes remove healthcare from our uninsured neighbors.
---
– His votes remove subsidies from our neighbors who subscribe to Pennie (Affordable Care Act) premiums.
---
– His votes keep the federal minimum wage stagnating at $7.25/hour.
---
– His votes permit our rogue president to waste our tax dollars and worldwide reputation on an endless war while the cost of fuel rises substantially.
---
Meanwhile, on Wednesday, I spent time celebrating the first anniversary of Chambersburg Area School District’s Engagement Center which serves over 300 homeless students.
---
On Wednesday night, I listened to the excellent presentation from SCCAP at Gearhouse brewery regarding the dearth of affordable housing in Franklin County. Bonus – I spent time with Shannon Jackson, running for Pennsylvania’s 89th House District, and his wife, Maribeth Fish, member of Team Beth Farnham for Congress.
---
And on Thursday, I toured a local food pantry, Hungry Hearts, in Chambersburg to understand how the community rises to meet the challenge of starvation Joyce leaves in his wake.
---
Many thanks to Desi Ortiz and First United Methodist Church for feeding those in need with a wide variety of fresh, as well as shelf stable, foods. Hungry Hearts is available on Thursdays from 9am to 11:30am.
---
But the lack of representative engagement doesn’t have to continue. We can be represented by me, instead of Joyce, and stop a rogue president from wasting our tax dollars on murder and using them instead to take care of our neighbors in need.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=1cd21e0eb44e8a23d2eed8971a02dcd16bbcb6ce057b3f0abc571a838c611bc3&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=60a1addaee0bb85381d7ce9813843cb4&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69) !
---
Photo credits: Maribeth Fish
---
| | **Interview!**
---
Many thanks to Dan Teodorescu for interviewing me today at Gettysburg College’s radio station WZBT 91.1 FM.
---
I appreciate the opportunity to promote my fight for our precious Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Affordability, and more.
---
| [](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=15791936a732f814fc146bb266e1bbeb95933d0e6bb861647c23388fd291c9f2&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b255410628a7770d92420c25e56f8d6d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj0wZGhlc2NlR3B2NCZsaXN0PVBMNHY3VUcxanZzU1BfTml6b1V4WGxQS2V1SVBUNzFWcHY&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)

---
| **Results**
---
While they didn’t win their special elections on March 17th, St. Patrick’s Day, Todd Crawley, Democratic Nominee for PA State Representative 193rd District, and Caleb McCoy, Democratic Nominee for PA State Representative 79th District, performed very well compared to how Harris lost in 2024.
---
Moreover, they still have another chance in the general election.
---
With over 95% of the votes counted Todd received 40.3% of the votes compared to Harris’s 30.5% in 2024.
---
With over 90% of the votes counted, Caleb received over 42.4% of the votes compared to Harris’s 33% in 2024.
---
November 3rd is over 7 months away and with this cruel and incompetent administration, A LOT can happen between now and then.
---
I say to Todd and Caleb,
---
“May the road rise up to meet you. May the wind be always at your back. May the sun shine warm upon your face, the rains fall soft upon your fields. And until we meet again, may God hold you in the palm of His hand.”
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!

[Mitigation Action and Watermen Support (MAWS) Act of 2026](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e62208e55c93a935af0a4f2b25b99a9be3144bada2a6d3615573fbbea7f76cf8&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d8c7e5956a899085eeac7c3d15096d4b&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly92b3Rlc21hcnQub3JnL2JpbGwvNDIwMDMvMTE2ODE5LzE3ODkxMS9taXRpZ2F0aW9uLWFjdGlvbi1hbmQtd2F0ZXJtZW4tc3VwcG9ydC1tYXdzLWFjdC1vZi0yMDI2IzExNjgxOQ=&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| No| Passed| Yes| Blue catfish are an invasive species, preying upon baby blue crabs, oysters, and rockfish, which are crucial products of our beloved Chesapeake Bay. Therefore it is correct to reduce their population and using them as pet food is an acceptable means to deal with their harvest.
[Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=19e58c41cb8193f8f8c792cdce9b1f7b39bf249221f571f86bc29cddccdc84ee&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=a0f9db892735f72ccc034c0bbcb58375&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly92b3Rlc21hcnQub3JnL2JpbGwvNDIwMDQvMTE2ODIyLzE3ODkxMS9zbWFsbC1idXNpbmVzcy1pbm5vdmF0aW9uLWFuZC1lY29ub21pYy1zZWN1cml0eS1hY3QjMTE2ODIy&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| America’s Seed Fund is critical for emerging and undercapitalized U.S. small businesses, but needed modernization.
[**H Con Res 38**
Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from unauthorized hostilities in the Islamic Republic of Iran](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=da1df93dd1ac378b3944af607660b61b1dd5a5a3d9b21adb4c98f4cc426550a0&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=40a4eabb69528d0c23b47f6d5cb475ff&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtY29uY3VycmVudC1yZXNvbHV0aW9uLzM4L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| No| Failed| Yes| Only Congress has the power to declare war and with good reason. Many representatives of The People must agree it is in the best interests of our nation to invoke the high costs, threats to our national security, and tests of our allyship with other nations that a war often brings. Most certainly, war should not be declared by the whims of a mad king.
[**H Res 1099**
Reaffirming Iran remains the largest state sponsor of terrorism](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=71487fda8dad48b7fe55466c36b7e451331d15e19455b37b73f79900c4b4b880&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=2255442c6e637dc0b6cdf1b2d9a64654&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtcmVzb2x1dGlvbi8xMDk5L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| Based on alleged training, fincancing, providing weapons, and safe havens of Islamic Jihad, Hamas, Hezbollah, and Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, it is reasonable to believe that Iran remains the largest state sponsor of terrorism. This did not justify Trump’s attack without a plan on Iran, however.
[**HR 7744**
Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2026](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=7f36740c645043c59b70ec778afe5ab5d7b3ad08e509c5b1e082d9fb0bbb610b&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=2ab0b11d12521c1b69fc2f5f2d193472&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC83NzQ0L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| No| Immigrations and Customs Enforcement (I.C.E.) must be abolished and Customs and Border Protection must be reformed before DHS is granted another penny. With the staggeringly low standards in hiring practices for ICE, there is no redemption for those who will readily forgo Due Process. Moreover, overstaying one’s visa to the point of an “illegal” status is a misdemeanor and not worthy of the incredible cruelty and defiance of human rights and dignity that ICE currently persues. Immigration courts must be properly staffed and the immigrant-to-citizen path must be clearer to obtain.
[**H Res 1100**
Directing the Committee on Ethics to preserve and publicly release records of the Committee’s review of violations or alleged violations of clause 9 (as it pertains to acts of sexual harassment) and clause 18 of rule XXIII of the Rules of the House of Representatives](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=a860737ba3bf5dfda176f4051f97eb7ba54f9a2d5960a3e49d57771c24db60f7&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=3b5bf879beb02802b9ec28133a40808d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtcmVzb2x1dGlvbi8xMTAwL3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Motion Agreed| Yes| Publicly releasing such records too soon can compromise the identity of victims.
[HR 6472 – Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=982fc77516329fa09bc78a647baf5729621682c378dccad21dfd59b0784387b7&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=3e22bc9971d90ef54aebee1cc52292f2&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC82NDcyL3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| Students in US territories should not have to pay more than in-state tuition to attend institutions of higher learning.
[S 723 – Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act of 2025](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=77c11b99000363f5130222d88e9fcb2514c3616e89e74d5f2aaaf607453f4118&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=ccf3bc19b520dfcc30cb46aca02b6e90&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3Mvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwvNzIzL3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| Native Americans deserve the opportunity to own property on tribal land through the mortgage process.
[HR 4758 – Homeowner Energy Freedom Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=acb83b7cb4879dc9c9ff32501e1731daf26c8251d84e5aa3251a25794fb9ab69&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d13d16a254294c8ee4497f015e10ff24&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC80NzU4L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| No| This Bill repeals many home efficiency programs that helped homeowners save energy by ending: the high-efficiency electric home rebate program, efficiency contractor training grants, funding for specific state building codes.
[HR 4626 – Don’t Mess With My Home Appliances Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=91bcbfb4bfc5ee6a46ee18a584990dc15616f09dbd3fa9edb8f13aed8f76742b&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=58e141b63f2617059d05843286ca284c&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC80NjI2L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| No| The Bill eliminates the DOE look back for reviewing and making periodic standards every six years in addition to revoking standards of efficiency.
[HR 6329 – Information Quality Assurance Act of 2025](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=af9245a45e050ba19118fd9ff01f920bedc2ba38bfa02def663c034158bb9aab&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=ccef1028a2d26b65dfd3504a15a3e37c&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC82MzI5L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| It’s just common sense to for the Office of Management and Budget to revise policy and require federal agencies to rely on the best reasonably available information and evidence.
[S 2503 – Rotorcraft Operations Transparency and Oversight Reform (ROTOR) Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=daa070080e4d921f062f0748bdffe506ae8c3cb34bf8015e8888332ec519851f&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=7d58b5a1c5e777c399dacab39459a2e8&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3Mvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwvMjUwMy90ZXh0&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| No| Failed| Yes| Relatives of those killed in the January 2025 crash supported this bipartisan Senate Bill because it is more stringent than the Graves House Bill.
[HR 2189 – Law-Enforcement Innovate to De-Escalate Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e15c3871dc644c730dcba95dcfd0b173499de43a7e48309ed3eb9fca0b37db16&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=f220c24ca0ab6d2ee9e312289fe011e0&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC8yMTg5L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| No| While less-than-lethal weapons are ostensibly less lethal than many firearms, they can still be lethal, especially when converted through kits designed for that pu
rpose. Repealing the power of the Gun Control Act to now allow convicted criminals, including domestic abusers, to create these “ghost guns” increases danger to American communities, especially by those who have not changed their ways.
[H J Res 72 – Relating to a national emergency by the President on February 1, 2025](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=b49189cead915feb10ac26f8fdd79a4e725c6abdac6c9d4004828f47c01bacbd&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=fb9413d5c84a259a2eb5778315ea0ea4&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2Utam9pbnQtcmVzb2x1dGlvbi83Mi90ZXh0&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| No| Passed| Yes| Agree with Rep. Bacon that Trump’s unjustified tariffs on China, Mexico, and Canada “have been a ‘net negative’ for the economy and are a significant tax that American consumers, manufacturers, and farmers are paying.” and that “Article I of the Constitution places authority over taxes and tariffs with Congress for a reason, but for too long, we have handed that authority to the executive branch. It’s time for Congress to reclaim that responsibility.”
[S 1383 – Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=65e5e124e4cfbdc6c39f8a3a4cd764d7c07b9d7cd197eef05c3e53f758b24825&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=90ce753e8c205bcd7b75efb07655c532&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3Mvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwvMTM4My90ZXh0&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed | No| Suppresses the votes of married women especially whose names do not match those on their birth certificates by requiring passports as proof of citizenship instead, in the event of registration for change of address, name change, change of political party, or unjust removal from voter rolls. Cost and burden of passport is virtually poll tax with disparate impact against women.
[HR 1531 – Pressure Regulatory Organizations To End Chinese Threats to (PROTECT) Taiwan Act ](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=ae00c19e65fced6f02eaaacbf9e3edda5735c1ca42aa649dfcef7f9590502574&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=69a4f072bbcef7cc23693718cdd7e2b3&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC8xNTMxL3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| Requires Department of the Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and the Securities and Exchange Commission to exclude China from the Group of Twenty;
the Bank for International Settlements;
the Financial Stability Board;
the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision;
the International Association of Insurance Supervisors; and
the International Organization of Securities Commissions, if China poses threat to Tawain or US interests.
[HR 6644 – To increase the supply of housing in America, and for other purposes](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e6125b1701d6617d1f54a06e1c1b1f954bbcb10a5b559862d2e449d08058c948&blog_id=213069660&post_id=6599&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=a7489fafa1110f4824c2cdcce006a022&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3MvaG91c2UtYmlsbC82NjQ0L3RleHQ&email_id=bd1c2a80a04c91deeaa3925938690d69)| Yes| Passed| Yes| Expanding available finance programs for affordable housing. Restricts veterans’ disability benefits from being considered as source of income.
If you’re like me, you love this country as much as I do and work to make a positive difference. In the midst of this Constitutional Crisis, please consider reaching out to your local Democratic committees or Democratic candidates so that we can strengthen our Democracy instead of letting it slide into fascism.

Sincerely,

Beth

As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you... | | | | | or ---|---|--- By Elizabeth Farnham on March 22, 2026 | District Round-up 03.22.26 Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here: | | | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- | ---|--- Franklin County Cares! How do the votes of our US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, actively harm his own constituency? – His votes remove food assistance from our hungry neighbors. – His votes remove healthcare from our uninsured neighbors. – His votes remove subsidies from our neighbors who subscribe to Pennie (Affordable Care Act) premiums. – His votes keep the federal minimum wage stagnating at $7.25/hour. – His votes permit our rogue president to waste our tax dollars and worldwide reputation on an endless war while the cost of fuel rises substantially. Meanwhile, on Wednesday, I spent time celebrating the first anniversary of Chambersburg Area School District’s Engagement Center which serves over 300 homeless students. On Wednesday night, I listened to the excellent presentation from SCCAP at Gearhouse brewery regarding the dearth of affordable housing in Franklin County. Bonus – I spent time with Shannon Jackson, running for Pennsylvania’s 89th House District, and his wife, Maribeth Fish, member of Team Beth Farnham for Congress. And on Thursday, I toured a local food pantry, Hungry Hearts, in Chambersburg to understand how the community rises to meet the challenge of starvation Joyce leaves in his wake. Many thanks to Desi Ortiz and First United Methodist Church for feeding those in need with a wide variety of fresh, as well as shelf stable, foods. Hungry Hearts is available on Thursdays from 9am to 11:30am. But the lack of representative engagement doesn’t have to continue. We can be represented by me, instead of Joyce, and stop a rogue president from wasting our tax dollars on murder and using them instead to take care of our neighbors in need. Together, we ! Photo credits: Maribeth Fish | | Interview! Many thanks to Dan Teodorescu for interviewing me today at Gettysburg College’s radio station WZBT 91.1 FM. I appreciate the opportunity to promote my fight for our precious Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Affordability, and more. | Together, we ! | Results While they didn’t win their special elections on March 17th, St. Patrick’s Day, Todd Crawley, Democratic Nominee for PA State Representative 193rd District, and Caleb McCoy, Democratic Nominee for PA State Representative 79th District, performed very well compared to how Harris lost in 2024. Moreover, they still have another chance in the general election. With over 95% of the votes counted Todd received 40.3% of the votes compared to Harris’s 30.5% in 2024. With over 90% of the votes counted, Caleb received over 42.4% of the votes compared to Harris’s 33% in 2024. November 3rd is over 7 months away and with this cruel and incompetent administration, A LOT can happen between now and then. I say to Todd and Caleb, “May the road rise up to meet you. May the wind be always at your back. May the sun shine warm upon your face, the rains fall soft upon your fields. And until we meet again, may God hold you in the palm of His hand.” Together, we #ChooseDemocracy! | | ---|--- Source: | $3.99/gallon of gas at the Sheetz in Cross Keys, Adams County?!? Thank multimillionaire John Joyce and his Republican cronies for not stopping our rogue president. Then vote for me in the May Primary election. If you’re a Democrat, my name will be printed on the ballot for you to choose. If you’re a Republican, you can write my name in and darken the corresponding bubble instead of picking Joyce. Together, we ! | | Charity of the Week! Please donate, if you can, to Diaper Depot out of Central Presbyterian in Chambersburg. Diaper Depot has diapers for children and adults in need and opens once a month to provide growing families with breakfast and these necessary items. Here is the info page: | | Dance for Democracy! So much fun at the Dance for Democracy! Thank you The People’s Town Hall of Gettysburg for hosting an uplifting get-together of music, food, and great company at the Beyond the Battle Museum last night. It was great to move and groove among like-minded people who care deeply about our county. We are refreshed to continue resisting a would-be king and his lackeys. Don’t forget – NO KINGS demonstrations will happen around the country on Saturday, March 28th, including in our own 13th Congressional District. Contact your county Democratic Committee for more details. * * *
As I previously reported, dogs in Skid Row are routinely abused or neglected by the drugged-out residents of the neighborhood. My time there in February was eye-opening and one of the worst things I have seen in my time doing field reporting because the abuse was easily seen.
The volunteers I was with told me they have spent years trying to get the Democrat officials to do something about it to little avail. Even though the dog rescuers have significantly fewer resources compared to the city and county of Los Angeles, they have done more to get dogs out of horrific conditions, get them treated, and place them into new homes.
Following my report, a local news station reached out to Mayor Karen Bass and Governor Gavin Newsom to see what their response was to not enforcing animal cruelty laws. Their responses were asinine.
Newsom's office passed the buck by saying while they do not want to see animal abuse take place, it is up to local officials to make sure it does not happen.
Bass' office said the volunteers were wrong about the city's efforts to stop the cruelty, calling such claims of inaction are "entirely false and irresponsible."

Let's look at the scoreboard.
So far in 2026: Gold is up 18+%. The average stock-heavy IRA isn't close.
Gold has been the best-performing major asset class for two straight years -- nearly doubling U.S. stock returns over the past 12 months. And most American retirement accounts still hold less than 1% of it.
This isn't a crisis trade. JPMorgan raised their 2026 forecast to $6,300 before the Iran escalation, before oil spiked, before stagflation entered the Fed's vocabulary. The structural case was already there. Current events just made it louder.
Most IRAs are still positioned for the world of 2021. The scoreboard in 2026 looks different.

* * *
_**(Piece continues)**_
I interviewed the Starts With One Today team and got their reaction to the statements.
"It's not about you and I disagreeing on how to approach it, you might as well have said, 'There's nobody living in tents on Skid Row'...You see the dogs suffering, like, we can't make these dogs suffer, we're not making up the videos," Victoriah Bech said.
Bech's husband, Jonathan, said he feels it is unfair that laws regarding pets are not applied to homeless people when taxpayers have to follow them.
"You should do what you're supposed to, even more [since] you're not paying taxes," he said.
Jonathan said homeless people have laughed in their faces while rescuing dogs because they know police or animal control often don't respond to obvious cases of abuse.
Volunteer Joey Tuccio blasted Bass because, "She has no idea what she's doing!"
"We've never seen her there, in fact, we've never seen any councilpeople there, to be honest. She just waffles so much," he continued.

"All this learning and investigating and figuring things out. People and animals are dying while they're comparing notes. It's so frustrating," he added.

body:
Stories like this are why we fight
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260322-2639)
Peter,
For this week's Sustainer Sunday, we’re bringing you a story from Heather Wiik-DuBois, a hardworking mom from Calumet County who has seen firsthand how the healthcare system is failing vulnerable people.
* * *
_As a kid, I watched our healthcare system fail the people around me. My family couldn't afford dental care, and I had cavities. After researching on the school computer, I made the decision to pull the affected teeth myself. No child should ever have to experience that kind of pain when the treatment should be simple and affordable._
_I went on to work in healthcare as a certified Community-Based Residential Facility (CBRF) caregiver. For years, I witnessed how the system mistreats our elders – they're left isolated, abandoned and stripped of everything they built while the system protects the ones profiting from their situation._
_I was a salaried manager making $13 an hour and working 100-hour pay periods. My bonus for keeping things running? A $20 gas card. That's when I got radicalized about workers' rights, and about our right to have a life outside of our labor._
_I'm almost 37. My youngest is 13. I've worked through most of my children's lives, and there's still no relief in sight. The working class is becoming the new corporate slave class, and we have to fight back._
_That's why I support Fran. I've agreed with everything she stands for since before she ran for anything — service to community, civility, consideration, and kindness for all people._
_– Heather Wiik-DuBois, Calumet County_

In the legislature, Fran fought for safe staffing mandates in nursing homes and hospitals. As governor, she'll expand Medicaid, crack down on insurance companies that deny care, and make the billion-dollar hospital systems that pay nothing in taxes start investing in the communities they serve.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Ten hospitals a day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9663%2E5257348%2EVF-exe)
Derek, do you know how much we’re spending a day on war in Iran? _$1 billion._ And do you know how much it costs, on average, to build a hospital in the United States? _$100 million._ **So we are dropping the equivalent of ten hospitals a day on Iran in a war with no congressional authorization.** Not a month goes by when I am not on the phone with a rural hospital CEO, or visiting a hospital at risk of closing their doors. With the big ugly bill and its trillion dollar cut to Medicaid, there will be hospitals and clinics closing their doors all across America. With the money we are spending in Iran on the war, we could be building new hospitals, not closing them down. This is, of course, only one of the terrible tradeoffs of this war. Derek, this is exactly what’s wrong with the Trump administration’s priorities. We are losing the lives of service members and spending billions of dollars that could be used to improve people’s quality of life here in the U.S. For every day Trump continues his Iran War, we are leaving ten more communities without a hospital, and patients who have to drive farther to get the care they need to stay alive. Trump thinks this war is a better use of our taxpayer money. It’s not, and it’s high time we have a Democratic majority in the Senate and the House that will make a difference for the hard-working Americans. Thank you, Adam | [DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/6050?t=4&akid=9663%2E5257348%2EVF-exe)

Do you have any tattoos?
I ask because I have this one that was inspired by one of my heroes, the late Congressman John Lewis.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/154ea3c9-d386-4840-b7df-e0ff8b6f8f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The Black heart represents the struggle of Black people.** It's a struggle every Black American faces throughout their life. As a Black man, running for Congress, that's the ultimate sign I've persevered through the struggles.
**The blood tears are for all the bloodshed Black Americans cast** , especially from historic events like Bloody Sunday. Hundreds of Black heroes, like John Lewis, took beatings that day -- and some even laid down their lives so that people like me could have a voice in our democracy.
**And the red lightning symbolizes the chaos** that ensues when you get into good trouble. Because like John Lewis said, "get in good trouble, necessary trouble, and help redeem the soul of America."
_**It 's because of my heroes that I have the opportunity to run for Congress and be one of the loudest voices fighting for our democracy. I'm following the path they carved for Black Americans.**_
Right now, I want to make a promise -- when I'm elected to serve Maryland's 5th district in Congress, I will support the John Lewis Voting Rights Act from Day 1.
It's never been more important to defend voting rights as Republicans fight tooth and nail to gut what's left of the Voting Rights Act and pass the SAVE Act to disenfranchise MILLIONS of voters.
**[Part of protecting our democracy means defending voting rights so more people around the country are participating in elections. Will you chip in a donation so I can support voting rights in Congress?](https://substack.com/redirect/154ea3c9-d386-4840-b7df-e0ff8b6f8f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Harry Dunn

subject: New York Times: "People Are Going Silent"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

Peter,
Before I ran for the U.S. Senate, I was an investigative journalist leading a team that exposed corruption and human rights abuses worldwide.
This report in _The New York Times_ reminded me of what I saw in many of those investigations:
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260322-2-f&t=1&akid=1915%2E5691347%2E7_1XUR)
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation.
From the article:
_Fired federal workers who are worried about losing their homes ask not to be quoted by name. University presidents fearing that millions of dollars in federal funding could disappear are holding their fire. Chief executives alarmed by tariffs that could hurt their businesses are on mute. ..._
_“When you see important societal actors — be it university presidents, media outlets, C.E.O.s, mayors, governors — changing their behavior in order to avoid the wrath of the government, that’s a sign that we’ve crossed the line into some form of authoritarianism,” said Steven Levitsky, a professor of government at Harvard and the co-author of the influential 2018 book “How Democracies Die.”_
**This is unacceptable in the United States of America.**
Peter — As Trump dismantles checks on his power and purges the government to fill every office with loyalists, more and more Americans are too afraid of retaliation to speak up.
**This descent into an un-American America must be stopped. We must regain Congressional power.**
I’m the ONLY Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won.
That means I’m MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
**Help me beat them again, just like we did in 2021.**
[**Please contribute to my campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260322-2-f&t=2&akid=1915%2E5691347%2E7_1XUR)
Thank you for chipping in if you can.
\- Jon

My name is Alex Vindman, and I wanted you to hear directly from me: I am running for the United States Senate in Florida.
I’ll explain more about why I chose to run, but if you already know the stakes of this race — and are fired up to defeat Donald Trump’s top ally in the Senate — then please become a Founding Donor by splitting a donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild:
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
I swore an oath to protect this country when I joined the U.S. Army more than two decades ago.
In 2019, I honored that oath by blowing the whistle on Donald Trump’s corrupt phone call with Ukraine, an act that led to Trump’s first impeachment and ultimately cost me my military career.
People told me to keep my head down. But my family came here as refugees to escape tyranny. I sure as hell wasn’t going to bow down to a wannabe tyrant.
This president unleashed a reign of terror and retribution, not just against me and my family, but against all of us.
Today, our country is in chaos. We are entering a dark chapter of American history, one that echoes early stages of authoritarian power consolidation seen elsewhere.
Thug militias attacking citizens. Tariffs pushing prices sky-high. Healthcare premiums through the roof. While all of this is happening, my opponent refuses to put the interests of the American people before her own self-interest.
Ashley Moody screwed Florida homeowners by caving to the big insurance companies, supported this administration that gutted disaster help for communities trying to rebuild, and had over a million dollars in her corporate stock traded last year while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
They put Ashley Moody in the Senate to be a ‘yes’ vote for Trump and the billionaires. She’s not Florida’s senator. She’s theirs.
We need someone who isn’t afraid to put a check on an outlaw president, to defend our democracy, and to make sure that every American has a fair chance at prosperity.
That is why I am running for Senate, and why I am humbly asking you:
Will you split a donation of any amount between my Senate campaign in Florida and Resist Reclaim Rebuild before midnight? Your donations add up quickly when everyone is chipping in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
CHIP IN TODAY TO HELP DEMS FLIP THE SENATE! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
The billionaires and special interests will throw everything they’ve got to try and stop us. But in the infantry, we didn’t back down from a fight — we went towards it. Join me.
Thank you.
Alex Vindman
